content:
Math And Diagrams In MDX

.mdx pages support the same math and Mermaid syntax as Markdown pages.

Inline

The quadratic formula is x = \frac{-b \pm \sqrt{b^2 - 4ac}}{2a}. Prices like $5 or $10 stay plain text.

Display

\nabla \cdot \mathbf{E} = \frac{\rho}{\varepsilon_0}
f(x) = \sum_{n=0}^{\infty} \frac{f^{(n)}(a)}{n!}(x - a)^n

Diagrams

flowchart LR
  Write[Write MDX] --> Compile[Compile]
  Compile --> Render["$$e^{i\pi} + 1 = 0$$"]

Math works next to MDX shortcodes such as callouts and <CharacterNote>.
